en: Oghayogagocchaka (The Group on Floods and Yokes)

Dependent on a state that is a flood (*ogha*), a state that is a flood arises by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*) … [as before] … Dependent on a state that is a bond (*yoga*), a state that is a bond arises by way of root-condition … [as before] … (Both groups are similar to the group of taints [*āsava*]; there is no difference between them.)
The Chapter on Floods, Yokes, and Clusters is finished.
